checks.evidence: Authentication level selection when account AAL and new authenticator AAL are equal, steps 1-2: account at AAL2 and new AAL2 authenticator; the system prompts for authentication and accepts AAL2 credentials before binding.
Rejection of authentication below the required lower AAL, step 2: only AAL1 credentials are given for an AAL2 binding; authentication is rejected and the binding is not completed.

invented: Test 1 expects an account with maximum AAL1 to bind an AAL2 authenticator after AAL1 authentication; this is not stated in the requirement.
